title: Eccentric coaxial capacitor: two line charges (electrostatics, analytic)
description:
Coaxial line cross-section with the core (radius a) shifted by e from the shield axis: the core perimeter held at V0 by a voltage feature on the circle (its boundary cells; the interior follows), the shield (every cell with r > b about the shield axis) a 0 V terminal, fill eps_fill. The sweep runs e over 0-1 mm (the last value is the largest, so the line curves show a strongly eccentric field).
Analytic (image line charges at the common inverse points of both circles, p on the axis through the centres and b^2 / p): V = V0 ln(|p r - b^2 x_hat| / (b |r - p x_hat|)) / D, D = acosh((a^2 + b^2 - e^2) / (2 a b)) (= ln(b / a) at e = 0), C' = 2 pi eps0 eps_fill / D per m of depth.
Derived values tab: C_per_m (core charge / voltage), Q_shield (= -C' V0), W_field (integral of E.D / 2 = C' V0^2 / 2) and V_wide (probe in the wide gap) with their references; expect ~1 % (staircased circles; the narrow gap concentrates the field).
Sweep tab: C_per_m vs e with the dashed acosh law (C' grows by 30 % at e = 1 mm).
Line profile tab (e = 1 mm): V_axis (field V) and E_x_axis (field E_x) along the line through both centres.
Twin: coax_capacitor_electrostatics (concentric, terminals).

parameters.name: V0
parameters.description: core voltage [V]; the shield is held at 0 V

parameters.name: e_off
parameters.description: core offset along +x from the shield axis (swept; a multiple of dx_cell)

parameters.name: eps_fill
parameters.description: static relative permittivity of the fill (PTFE ~2.1)

parameters.name: L_box
parameters.description: domain side; the shield fills every cell with r > b

parameters.name: x_c
parameters.description: shield axis x (a cell vertex, so the staircase is symmetric)

parameters.name: u_ecc
parameters.description: acosh argument of the eccentric capacitance (2.125 at e = 0)

parameters.name: D_ecc
parameters.description: acosh(u_ecc) = 2 pi eps0 eps_fill / C' (ln(b / a) = 1.386 at e = 0, 1.067 at e = 1 mm)

parameters.name: p_charge
parameters.description: x offset of the inner image line charge from the shield axis (inside the core; 0 at e = 0; the outer one sits at b^2 / p_charge)

parameters.name: x_wide
parameters.description: probe x relative to the shield axis: wide gap, a cell centre

parameters.name: y_wide
parameters.description: probe y relative to the shield axis (a cell centre)

analytic_curves.name: V_axis
analytic_curves.expression: where(hypot(x - x_c - e_off, y - y_c) <= a_core, V0, where(hypot(x - x_c, y - y_c) >= b_shield, 0, V0*log(hypot(p_charge*(x - x_c) - b_shield**2, p_charge*(y - y_c))/(b_shield*hypot(x - x_c - p_charge, y - y_c)))/D_ecc))

analytic_curves.name: E_x_axis
analytic_curves.expression: where((hypot(x - x_c - e_off, y - y_c) > a_core)*(hypot(x - x_c, y - y_c) < b_shield), V0*((x - x_c - p_charge)/((x - x_c - p_charge)**2 + (y - y_c)**2) - p_charge*(p_charge*(x - x_c) - b_shield**2)/((p_charge*(x - x_c) - b_shield**2)**2 + (p_charge*(y - y_c))**2))/D_ecc, 0)
